answer: The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in raven, expire in sable, and jade lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 75 aliases as a result needs 182 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4536 identities would post 2886 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
